snippet.title: How to reverse engineer Senja with Claude: what passed and what broke
snippet.description:
Claude built a Senja alternative from one Markdown spec: all 32 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 42 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 11 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a small-team testimonial wall and had it build the tool in four phases: a public form with a permission checkbox, personal invitations, a review queue, and a public wall with an embed. The gaps included a second moderator silently replacing the featured quote, a quote starting with = that could run as a spreadsheet formula in the CSV export, and an embed header that blocked the local test page. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Senja is still worth paying for.
